3d.an_autonomous_agent_building_a_game_a: I-ejenti ezimele eyakha umdlalo, isimo, i-NFT, noma impahla yemakethe idinga i-3D — futhi idinga ukwethemba lokho ekutholayo. Le API iphendula kokubili phakathi nomsebenzi: ngakhele imodeli kusuka kule ncazelo, futhi ingabe le modelyinhle, futhi ngingayinciphisa kanjani? Ayikho enye inkundla yokukhokha yama-ejenti enikeza mahhala ukukhiqizwa kwe-3D nokuhlolwa.
3d.assembled_live_from_the_api_catalog_ever: Kuhlanganiswe bukhoma kusuka kukhathalogi ye-API. Umugqa ngamunye umahhala futhi awudingi ukhiye.
3d.copy_run_done_no_key_no_header: Kopisha, sebenzisa, kwenziwe. Akukho ukhiye, akukho sihloko, akukho akhawunti. Lokhu kubiza i-API yokukhiqiza ebukhoma.
3d.everything_the_api_touches_is_a_real: Konke okuthintwa yi-API kuyi-GLB yangempela, ehambisana nezindinganiso — ifomethi efanayo injini yakho, isibukeli, noma indawo yemakethe esivele iyikhuluma. Hudula ukuze ujikeleze.
3d.give_your_ai_agent_a_3d_toolchain: Nikeza i-ejenti yakho ye-AI ithuluzi le-3D. Guqula umyalo wombhalo ube yi-GLB yangempela enokuthungwa, qinisekisa futhi ulungiselele noma iyiphi i-glTF/GLB — mahhala, ayidingi ukhiye, ayidingi akhawunti. Uma uhlaka lunganele, i-API efanayo idlulela kumazinga okukhiqiza e-Forge Pro kanye nama-Rigged Avatars alungele ukugqwayiza.
3d.is_it_really_free_and_keyless: Ingabe umahhala ngempela futhi awudingi ukhiye?
3d.meta_description: I-API ye-3D yamahhala, engadingi ukhiye yama-ejenti e-AI: guqula umyalo wombhalo ube yi-GLB yangempela, qinisekisa futhi ulungiselele noma iyiphi i-glTF/GLB, bese udlulela kumazinga ekhwalithi ekhokhelwayo e-Forge Pro kanye nama-Rigged Avatars. I-URL eyodwa yokuthola konke — akukho akhawunti, akukho ukhiye we-API.
3d.meta_og_description: I-3D yamahhala, engadingi ukhiye yama-ejenti: ukukhiqizwa kohlaka lwe-text→3D + ukuhlolwa kwe-glTF/GLB, ngombhalo ohlanzekile we-OpenAPI 3.1 kanye ne-ladder ekhokhelwayo yekhwalithi yokukhiqiza.
3d.meta_og_title: three.ws I-API ye-3D — i-text→3D yamahhala + ukuhlolwa kwama-ejenti e-AI
3d.meta_title: three.ws I-API ye-3D — i-text→3D yamahhala + ukuhlolwa kwama-ejenti e-AI
3d.meta_twitter_description: I-API ye-3D yamahhala, engenakhiye yama-ejenti e-AI: guqula umyalo wombhalo ube imodeli yangempela ye-GLB futhi uqinisekise/ulungiselele noma iyiphi i-glTF/GLB, konke kusuka ku-URL eyodwa enesipeki esibukhoma se-OpenAPI 3.1. Ukukhiqizwa kwesakhiwo samahhala nokuhlolwa kuthuthukela kumazinga ekhwalithi ekhokhelwayo ye-Forge Pro nama-Avatar Ahlomile alungele ukugqwayiza. Akukho khiye, akukho akhawunti.
3d.output_is_binary_gltf_glb_the_web: Okukhiphayo kuyi-glTF kanambambili (GLB) — isiqukathi se-3D esijwayelekile sewebhu esifundwa yiyo yonke injini nesibukeli. Ukuhlolwa kwamukela .glb kanye .gltf kusuka kunoma iyiphi i-URL yomphakathi, kuze kufike kumkhawulo wosayizi obhalwe phansi.
3d.point_any_openapi_toolchain_at_it: Khomba noma iyiphi i-OpenAPI toolchain kuyo
3d.pre_baked_idle_walk_clip_library: Umtapo wezincwadi wamavidiyo wokungasebenzi / wokuhamba osekulungisiwe
3d.programmatically_over_x402_http_402_usdc: Ngokuhlelekile, nge-x402 (HTTP 402 + USDC ku-Base noma Solana). Akukho ukushintshaniswa kokhiye — i-ejenti ivele iphinde izame isicelo ngekhanda lokukhokha. Bheka i-x402 Bazaar ekhokhelwayo ukuze uthole ikhathalogi ephelele.
3d.start_free_upgrade_only_when_a_draft: Qala mahhala. Thuthukisa kuphela uma isakhiwo singanele. Amazinga akhokhelwayo akhokha ngocingo ngalunye ku-USDC nge-x402 — kusengakho akhawunti, kusengakho khiye.
3d.text_3d_draft_nim_trellis_single_subject: Isakhiwo sombhalo→3D (NIM TRELLIS): isihloko esisodwa, GLB, akukho ukuhlomisa
3d.this_is_a_live_gltf_binary_rendered: Lena yi-glTF kanambambili ebukhoma ekhonjiswe kusiphequluli sakho. I-endpoint yamahhala /api/3d/inspect ibika ngqo ukuthi yini ngaphakathi kwalezi — ama-vertices, onxantathu, izinto zokwakha, ukuthungwa, ukugqwayiza, izandiso — kanye nohlelo olubekwe eqhulwini lokuyenza ibe ncane futhi isheshe.
3d.yes_no_account_no_api_key_no: Yebo. Akukho akhawunti, akukho khiye we-API, akukho isikhwama. Ama-endpoint amahhala anomkhawulo wesilinganiso esikhulu nge-IP ngamunye omane uvimbele ukuhlukumeza. Izinga lokukhiqizwa kwesakhiwo samahhala lisebenza kumzila we-GPU owabelwe — liqotho ngokuba yizinga lokwenza izifanekiso (ijiyomethri yesakhiwo, GLB kuphela, akukho ukuhlomisa).

I-avatar engezansi iboshelwe esimweni esiku-chain somsebenzi ngekhompomenti yewebhu <three-ws-agent> ehlela /api/agenc/get-task futhi iphinde ifake imibala endaweni njengoba umsebenzi udlula ku-Open → Claimed → Completed. I-halo enemibala eyindilinga ezungeze i-avatar iyisibonakaliso sokubonakala; uma i-avatar GLB iqukethe iziqeshana zokugqwayiza, isici esingakhethwa agenc-clips sishintsha iziqeshana ngesimo ngasinye. arm.meta_description: Lungiselela umenzeli wakho we-3D ukuthi enze ngokuzenzakalelayo ngokusekelwe ekukholweni kwe-Oracle: setha amaphuzu amancane, usayizi wesikhundla, imikhawulo yansuku zonke neyezikhundla ezivulekile, izihlungi zezindaba nezixwayiso, bese umhlomisa ngemodi yokulingisa noma ebukhoma. Sonke isenzo sihlolwa ngokusekelwe kumphumela.
arm.meta_og_description: Setha imithetho, hlomisa umenzeli wakho we-3D, bese umvumela ukuthi ahwebe ngokukholwa kwe-Oracle kusuka esikhwameni sakhe se-custodial Solana — lingisa kuqala, bese uya bukhoma uma usumethemba.

arm.meta_twitter_description: Imithetho, usayizi, imikhawulo, izexwayiso — bese uhlomisa. Umenzeli wakho we-3D wenza ngokushesha lapho uhlamvu lwemali ludlula umkhawulo wakho.

Iqala ku-lingisa ukuze ukwazi ukuyibuka isebenza ngaphandle kwengozi, bese uya bukhoma uma usumethemba.

arm.when_should_your_agent_buy_only_plays: Umenzeli wakho kufanele athenge nini? Imidlalo kuphela ehlangabezana nayo yonke imithetho engezansi eyenziwayo.

artifact_index.glbs_over_6_mb_are_rejected_claude: GLBs ezingaphezu kuka-6 MB ziyenqatshelwa — iphaneli ye-artifact ka-Claude ingase ilenge kumalayisha amakhulu afakwe ngaphakathi. Isibukeli sengeza u-565 KB ngaphezulu kwemodeli.
artifact_index.meta_description: Faka umenzeli we-three.ws osebenzisanayo ngaphakathi kwe-artifact ye-Claude.ai. I-HTML ezimele, akukho ukuncika kwangaphandle.
artifact_index.meta_og_description: Ibonisa amabhundle e-artifact ka-Claude njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezizimele ezifakekayo.
artifact_index.meta_twitter_description: Ibonisa amabhundle e-artifact ka-Claude njengezinhlelo zokusebenza ezizimele ezifakekayo.
artifact_index.paste_a_single_url_into_a_claude: Namathisela i-URL eyodwa engxoxweni kaClaude. Impendulo iyi-HTML document eyodwa ezimele yodwa — i-three.js, i-GLTFLoader, kanye ne-GLB ye-agent yakho konke kufakwe ngaphakathi. Ayikho i-script evinjwe yi-CSP ye-sandbox kaClaude, akukho ukulanda okushiya ikhasi.
artifact_index.the_response_sets_a_csp_mirroring_claude: Impendulo isetha i-CSP efana neyakwaClaude. Ukuziphatha ekubukeni kuqala okubukhoma kufana nokuziphatha ngaphakathi kuClaude.ai — akukho okumangazayo phakathi kwe-staging ne-prod.
artifact_index.three_js_gltfloader_and_the_glb_are: I-three.js, i-GLTFLoader, kanye ne-GLB konke kufakwe ngaphakathi. Ikhasi libonakala ngaphandle kwezingcingo zenethiwekhi — ihambisana ngokugcwele ne-CSP ye-sandbox kaClaude evimbela ukulanda nama-script angaphandle.

assistant.meta_description: Faka umsizi we-avatar ye-3D kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngethegi elilodwa le-script. Imodi ye-chatbot (amamodeli amahhala noma ukhiye wakho we-Groq/OpenRouter) nemodi yokukhuluma — i-avatar isho noma yini oyithayiphayo, ngokuzwakalayo, ngebhamuza lokukhuluma.
assistant.meta_og_description: Faka umsizi we-avatar ye-3D kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngethegi elilodwa le-script. Imodi yengxoxo nemodi yokukhuluma, izizinda ezingabonakali noma ezi-gradient, amamodeli amahhala noma ulethe ukhiye wakho.
assistant.meta_twitter_description: Faka umsizi we-avatar ye-3D kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi ngethegi elilodwa le-script. Imodi yengxoxo nemodi yokukhuluma, izizinda ezingabonakali noma ezi-gradient, amamodeli amahhala noma ulethe ukhiye wakho.
assistant.one_script_tag_adds_a_floating_launcher: Ithegi elilodwa le-script lifaka isiqalisi esintantayo kusayithi lakho. Chofoza kuso bese kuvela i-avatar ye-3D yangempela, epopayiwe — ngemuva kwekhasi lakho, umbala, noma i-gradient — ngezindlela ezimbili: i-chatbot ephendula imibuzo (amamodeli amahhala, noma ulethe ukhiye wakho we-Groq / OpenRouter), nemodi yokukhuluma lapho i-avatar isho khona ngqo okuthayiphayo, ngokuzwakalayo, ngebhamuza lokukhuluma.
assistant.paste_it_before_on_any_site_chat: Namathisela ngaphambi kwe-</body> kunoma iyiphi isayithi. Izimpendulo zengxoxo zivela ochungechungeni lwamamodeli amahhala (Groq → OpenRouter → NVIDIA) ngokuzenzakalelayo; izivakashi zingashintshela kukhiye wazo we-Groq noma we-OpenRouter kuzilungiselelo zewijethi — okhiye bahlala kusiphequluli sazo. Imodi yokukhuluma isebenzisa amazwi akhelwe ngaphakathi esiphequluli. Amadokhumenti agcwele: /docs.
assistant.type_anything_and_the_avatar_says_it: Thayipha noma yini futhi i-avatar iyayisho ngokuzwakalayo nge-bubble yokukhuluma — i-text-to-speech yesiphequluli, amazwi akhethekayo, akukho mali.
assistant.use_a_built_in_body_any_three: Sebenzisa umzimba owakhelwe ngaphakathi, noma iyiphi i-id ye-avatar ye-three.ws (yenza eyodwa ku-Forge), i-URL ye-GLB, noma umzimba we-agent nge-data-agent.

autopilot.meta_description: Faka uhlamvu lwakho lwemali lwe-pump.fun ku-autopilot. I-agent yakho yenza ukuthenga kabusha futhi isabalalise izimali zabakhi kubanikazi ngokuya ngemithetho oyibekile — futhi ilandise konke okwenzeka ku-chain ngesikhathi sangempela.

autopilot.meta_twitter_description: I-cockpit yethokheni engadingi ukubanjwa: setha imithetho — ukuthenga, ukuthengisa, kanye nezivikelo — futhi uvumele i-agent yakho isebenzise uhlamvu lwemali ngokuzimela.
autopilot.your_agent_runs_the_whole_coin_lifecycle: I-agent yakho isebenzisa wonke umjikelezo wempilo yohlamvu lwemali yodwa: iyathenga kabusha futhi ishise kusuka ezimalini zabakhi futhi isabalalise izinkokhelo kubanikazi — ngokuya ngemithetho oyibekile. Konke okwenzeka ku-chain kulandiswa bukhoma yi-avatar ye-agent yakho.

autopilot_activity.every_action_your_agent_took_on_your: Zonke izenzo umenzeli wakho azenzile egameni lakho — ngasinye sisekelwe enkumbulweni esisishukumisile, sisayiniwe, futhi singahlehliswa lapho kungenzeka khona. Lokhu kungukuzimela ongakuhlola.

avatar_engines.a_factual_map_of_the_open_source: Imephu enembile yezinhlelo zomthombo ovulekile nezokuhweba ezakha ama-avatar e-3D angokoqobo nasezingeni eliphezulu — amakhanda e-Gaussian-splat, abantu besithombe esisodwa, izakhi zama-avatar zombhalo→avatar, kanye nama-rigs three.ws asevele ewanyakazisa. Ngayinye: ukuthi yakha ini, isebenza ngani, yini imvume yayo yelayisense, nokuthi i-three.ws iyisebenzisa kanjani ngqo.
avatar_engines.commercial_use_only: Ukusetshenziswa kwezentengiso kuphela
avatar_engines.every_engine_for_a_high_quality_human: Yonke injini ye-avatar yomuntu esezingeni eliphezulu.
avatar_engines.listings_are_reference_material_compiled: Uhlu luyizinto zereferensi ezihlanganiswe kusuka endaweni yokugcina kanye nephepha lephrojekthi ngayinye, olusha kusukela ngoJuni 2026. Izifinyezo zamalayisense ziyisiqondiso, hhayi iseluleko sezomthetho — qinisekisa imigomo ngephrojekthi yokuqala ngaphambi kwanoma yikuphi ukusetshenziswa kwezentengiso. Izinjini zocwaningo ezingezona ezokuhweba zixhunywe ukuze zisetshenziswe ngokuzibamba nangokwezemfundo futhi azixhunyiwe ngamabomu ohlelweni lokukhiqiza olukhokhelwayo lwe-three.ws. Okuwukuphela kwethokheni i-three.ws elikubhekisela kulo yi-$THREE.

bnb.not_20_000_tps_marketing_three_product: Akuyona imakethe ye-"20,000 TPS" — amathrekhi amathathu omkhiqizo asebenzisa amakhono esiwahlolile ngokuzimela bukhoma ku-BNB Chain ngomhla ka-2026-07-07, okuyi-Ethereum L1, i-Base, kanye (ikakhulukazi) ne-Solana abangakwazi ukuwafanisa ngempela. Ikhadi ngalinye elingezansi lilandelela isimangalo salo kulokho esikulinganisile, lixhumanisa idemo yangempela lapho isithunyelwe, futhi lithi "iyeza maduze" — hhayi isixhumanisi esifile — lapho ingekho.
bnb.the_block_time_number_above_is_measured: Inombolo yesikhathi sebhulokhi engenhla ilinganiswa bukhoma kusuka ku-BSC RPC yomphakathi kukho konke ukulayishwa kwekhasi (probeBlockTime, kuthathwa amabhulokhi angama-200 angempela) — akukaze kube yi-"0.45s" eqinile.
bnb.three_things_only_bnb_chain_lets_us: Izinto ezintathu kuphela i-BNB Chain esivumela ukuba sizakhe.
bnb.we_never_claim_bnb_s_roadmap_targets: Asikaze sisho ukuthi izinhloso zendlela ye-BNB — i-20,000 TPS, ukuqedwa kwe-250ms (BEP-670), noma "uhlaka lwe-AI agent" olusezingeni le-chain — zithunyelwe. Kuphela lokho esikulinganise thina.

bnb_latency.a_chain_s_rpc_going_quiet_shows: I-RPC ye-chain ethulayo ibonisa "iyaxhuma kabusha" kuleyo ndlela kuphela; okunye komjaho kuyaqhubeka. Zonke ezine ziwile ngesikhathi esisodwa zibonisa iphutha eliklanywe ngokuzama kabusha, akukaze kube ikhasi elingenalutho.
bnb_latency.each_card_samples_real_blocks_or_slots: Ikhadi ngalinye lithatha amabhulokhi angempela (noma izikhala, ze-Solana) kusuka ku-RPC yomphakathi futhi libika isikhathi esilinganisiwe esijwayelekile — i-sparkline ingukufundwa okubukhoma kokugcina okungu-24, ibha ende kakhulu = isilinganiso esisheshayo.
bnb_latency.every_chain_s_public_rpc_is_unreachable: I-RPC yomphakathi ye-chain ngayinye ayifinyeleleki okwamanje — lokhu kungukuphazamiseka kwangempela, hhayi iphutha. Zama futhi, noma ubuye maduze.
bnb_latency.every_number_comes_from_which_samples_re: Inombolo ngayinye ivela ku-/api/bnb/latency, ethatha amabhulokhi angempela (i-BNB nge-probeBlockTime, umsebenzi ofanayo osekelayo i-proof strip ye-/bnb hub) kusuka kuma-RPC omphakathi kukho konke ukuhlola — akukho okubalwe ngaphambili noma okuyiqiniso.
bnb_latency.four_lanes_one_honest_race_bnb_chain: Izindlela ezine, umjaho owodwa othembekile: I-BNB Chain, i-Base, i-Ethereum, kanye ne-Solana, ngalinye lilinganiswa bukhoma kusuka ku-RPC yomphakathi njalo ngemizuzwana embalwa — akukaze kube yi-"0.45s" eqinile. Indlela ethulayo ibonisa "iyaxhuma kabusha," hhayi inombolo mbumbulu eqandisiwe, kuyilapho ezinye ziqhubeka nomjaho.

demo_avatar_os_combined.builds_the_face_mesh_and_parents_it: Yakha i-mesh yobuso futhi iyixhumanise nethambo lekhanda lomzimba (uma likhona) noma iyibeke phezulu ebhokisini lomzimba elibiyelwe.
demo_avatar_os_combined.frontal_photo_only_the_face_mesh_demo: Isithombe sangaphambili kuphela (i-demo ye-face mesh isebenzisa izithombe ezi-3).

demo_avatar_os_index.embeds_the_open_source_characterstudio_m: Ifaka umhleli we-CharacterStudio (M3-org / Apache-2.0) ovulekile. Khetha i-avatar eyisisekelo, yenza ngezifiso izici, thumela GLB. Kungena esikhundleni somhleli we-iframe ye-Avaturn.
demo_avatar_os_index.glb_export_uses_three_js_s_from: Ukuthumela kwe-GLB kusebenzisa i-GLTFExporter ye-three.js kusuka ku-three/addons.
demo_avatar_os_index.mediapipe_face_landmarker_apache_2_0_run: I-MediaPipe Face Landmarker (Apache-2.0) isebenza ngokuphelele esipheqululini ukwakha i-mesh ye-3D enokuthungwa kusuka ku-selfie eyodwa. Kungena esikhundleni se-API ye-Avaturn yokuguqula isithombe sibe i-avatar.
demo_avatar_os_index.mediapipe_tasks_vision_pulled_via_npm_wa: I-MediaPipe Tasks Vision idonswa nge-npm (@mediapipe/tasks-vision). Amafayela e-WASM + amamodeli alandwa ku-CDN yakwa-Google ngesikhathi sokusebenza.
demo_avatar_os_index.stitches_the_selfie_face_mesh_onto_a: Ihlanganisa i-mesh yobuso be-selfie kumzimba weStudio GLB bese ithumela okuhlanganisiwe okukodwa GLB. Okufana kakhulu nomkhiqizo wokugcina we-Avaturn.
demo_avatar_os_index.the_avatar_studio_is_the_existing_worksp: I-Avatar Studio iyindawo yokusebenza ekhona ye-character-studio/ (M3-org, AGPL — isabuyekezwa), etholakala ngomthombo ofanayo ku-/avatar-studio ekuthuthukisweni nasekukhiqizeni. Yakha kanye nge-npm --prefix character-studio run build, noma khomba i-VITE_CHARACTER_STUDIO_URL kuseva ye-studio ezimele.
demo_avatar_os_index.three_parallel_paths_replace_what_we_cur: Izindlela ezintathu ezifanayo zithatha indawo yalokho esikuthola manje ku-Avaturn. Idemo ngayinye isebenza ngokuphelele kusukela ekuqaleni kuye ekugcineni — thwebula, yenza, buka kuqala, thumela GLB. Awekho amamoki, awekho idatha mbumbulu.

demo_avatar_os_selfie.front_facing_photo_gives_the_best_face: Isithombe esibheke phambili sinikeza i-mesh yobuso engcono kakhulu. Izithombe eziseceleni ziyazikhethela (zisetshenziswa idemo ehlanganisiwe ukuze kube nereferensi eyengeziwe).
demo_avatar_os_selfie.runs_the_mediapipe_face_landmarker_on_th: Isebenzisa i-MediaPipe Face Landmarker esithombeni esingaphambili. Ukufanisa kwe-blendshape→morph kutholakala ku-src/voice/a2f-player.js — kusebenzisa kabusha ulwazimagama lwe-ARKit/VRM/Oculus oluku-src/voice/arkit-blendshapes.js, ngakho noma iyiphi i-rig yomuntu i-lip-sync ngaphandle kohlu oluvunyelwe lwe-rig ngayinye. Bona i-demo ye-lipsync ye-amplitude kuphela yendlela yokubuyela emuva yayo.
demos_audio2face.type_a_line_it_s_spoken_in: Thayipha umugqa. Ukhulunywa ngezwi lika NVIDIA Magpie, futhi lowo msindo oqondile uthunyelwa ku NVIDIA Audio2Face-3D, okubuyisa i-ARKit blendshape track ngayinye yohlaka. Umlomo nobuso be-avatar kuyanyakaza uhlaka ngohlaka nezwi langempela — okufaniswa kunoma iyiphi indlela ye-morph-target i-GLB elayishiwe eliyisebenzisayo (ARKit, i-avatar-platform evamile, VRM, Oculus visemes). Uma i-Audio2Face ingatholakali, i-avatar isazokhuluma futhi ibuyele ku-amplitude lipsync — akukaze kube ubuso obuqandisiwe.

Konke kusebenza kusiphequluli — akukho wallet, akukho ukubhala ku-chain, akukho RPC. Hambisa izilayidi, lingisa ukuthenga nokuthengisa ngokumelene nesipele esibonakalayo, bese ubuka intengo yamanje iphendula. Kuwusizo ekunqumeni isilinganiso sesipele kanye nomkhawulo wokuqhubekela phambili ngaphambi kokufaka amathokheni e-agent wangempela.

deployments.meta_twitter_description: Ukusakaza okubukhoma, okuwela amaketanga kwawo wonke ama-agent afika ku-chain — ERC-8004 ku-EVM kanye ne-Metaplex Core ku-Solana — ngesikhathi kuqinisekisa.
deployments.network_mainnet_sources_evm_solana_metap: Inethiwekhi: mainnet. Imithombo: erc8004_agents_index (EVM), agent_identities + solana_agents_index (Solana Metaplex), okuthathwe kuma-log eketanga. Ukufakwa okungenaso isikhathi se-block esiqinisekisiwe kubalwa kumanani aphelele kodwa akufakwa kumugqa wesikhathi.
deployments.portable_on_chain_agent_identity_across_: Ubunikazi be-agent obuthwalekayo ku-chain, ngamazinga amabili: ERC-8004 ibhalisa ama-agent ku-Identity Registry efakwe ekhelini elifanayo kuwo wonke amaketanga e-EVM, kanti ku-Solana i-agent ngayinye iyi-asset ye-Metaplex Core eyenziwe kuqoqo le-three.ws Agents futhi yabhaliswa ku-Metaplex Agent Registry. Faka eyakho kusuka ku-the studio noma hlola i-3D agent directory.

docs_walk_analytics.anonymous_walkers_count_too_signed_in_wa: Abahamba ngaphandle kwegama nabo bayabalwa. Abahamba abangene ngemvume babalelwa kuma-akhawunti abo; bonke abanye babhaliswa nge-id engaziwa ejikelezayo, ngakho uhlu lwabahamba phambili kanye nenani lakho kusabafaka.
docs_walk_analytics.beyond_automatic_metrics_fire_your_own_e: Ngaphezu kwezilinganiso ezizenzakalelayo, qala imicimbi yakho ukuze ulinganise okubalulekile — ukubhalisa, ukuthenga, ukudlala. Kusuka ekhasini elisebenzisa i-walk runtime:
docs_walk_analytics.distinct_host_sites_the_avatar_walked_on: Izindawo zokusingatha ezihlukile i-avatar ehambe kuzo.
docs_walk_analytics.each_event_posts_immediately_events_are_: Umcimbi ngamunye uthumela ngokushesha (imicimbi ayivamile, ngokungafani nezilinganiso ezihlanganisiwe) futhi ubalelwa ku-avatar efanayo nomhambi njengeseshini ezungezile. Ideshibhodi ikhombisa inani lomcimbi ngamunye kanye nezinga lawo lokuguqulwa ngokumelene namaseshini.
docs_walk_analytics.every_avatar_you_own_has_a_private: Yonke i-avatar oyiphethe inedeshibhodi yezibalo yangasese ku-three.ws/walk-analytics — amaseshini, ibanga, isikhathi, lapho ihambe khona, kanye nemicimbi yokuguqulwa oyenzayo wena. Zonke izibalo zivela emsebenzini wangempela wokuhamba; akukho okusampulwe noma okulinganiselwe.
docs_walk_analytics.meta_description: Izibalo zokushumeka ze-Walk: izikhathi zokusetshenziswa, isikhathi esimaphakathi, ibanga elihanjwe, imvelaphi yokushumeka eyingqayizivele, uchungechunge lwesikhathi lwansuku zonke, abasingathi abaphambili, kanye nemicimbi yokuguqulwa echazwe umdali eqaliswe nge-ThreeWalkAvatar.track.
docs_walk_analytics.metres_walked_summed_from_per_frame_move: Amamitha ahambwe, ahlanganiswe kusukela ekunyakazeni kwefreyimu ngayinye.
docs_walk_analytics.no_third_party_tracking_metrics_flow_onl: Akukho ukulandelela okuvela eceleni. Izilinganiso zigeleza kuphela ku-three.ws ingest; akukho mhlinzeki wezibalo wangaphandle ochungechungeni.
docs_walk_analytics.owner_only_the_dashboard_api_requires_a: Okomnikazi kuphela. I-API yedeshibhodi idinga iseshini engenwe ngemvume (noma ithokheni yomphathi enesilinganiso se-avatars:read) futhi iqinisekisa ukuthi ungumnikazi we-avatar — abanye bathola i-403.
docs_walk_analytics.per_day_sessions_distance_and_duration_g: Izikhathi zokusetshenziswa zansuku zonke, ibanga, nesikhathi — izikhala zigcwaliswe ngama-zero ukuze kube negrafu eqhubekayo.
docs_walk_analytics.sessions_counted_across_the_selected_win: Izikhathi zokusetshenziswa ezibalwe kuyo yonke iwindi ekhethiwe.
docs_walk_analytics.the_embed_host_which_site_the_avatar: Umphathi wokushumeka (ukuthi i-avatar ihambe kusiphi isayithi) ithathwa ohlangothini lweseva kusuka ku-header ye-Origin/Referer yesicelo — ayikaze ithenjwe kusuka kumzimba wesicelo. "Imvelaphi yakho eyingqayizivele" ikhombisa lapho i-avatar yagijima khona ngempela.
docs_walk_analytics.the_ingest_accepts_this_batch_all_fields: I-ingest yamukela leli qoqo (zonke izinkambu ziyazikhethela ngaphandle uma kuphawuliwe):
docs_walk_analytics.the_runtime_unlocks_a_fixed_set_of: I-runtime ivula isethi eqondile yempumelelo, egcinwe kanye ngayinye:
docs_walk_analytics.the_top_10_embed_hosts_by_session: Abasingathi abaphezulu abayi-10 bokushumeka ngokwenani lezikhathi zokusetshenziswa.
docs_walk_analytics.the_walk_runtime_accumulates_two_running: I-runtime ye-Walk iqoqa izibalo ezimbili eziqhubekayo — ibanga elivundlile nesikhathi seseshini (wall-clock) — futhi ikhipha iqoqo elincane ku-POST /api/walk/metrics cishe njalo ngemizuzwana engama-60, kanye kanye lapho ikhasi lifihliwe nge-navigator.sendBeacon. Iqoqo elilodwa liba umugqa owodwa wokuhlanganisa wansuku zonke, ngakho ihora lokuhamba liyimigqa embalwa, hhayi izinkulungwane.
docs_walk_analytics.total_walk_time_total_sessions: Isikhathi esiphelele sokuhamba ÷ izikhathi zokusetshenziswa eziphelele.
docs_walk_analytics.your_conversion_events_with_a_count_and: Imicimbi yakho yokuguqulwa enenani kanye nesilinganiso sokuguqulwa (imicimbi ÷ izikhathi zokusetshenziswa).

docs_walk_changelog.meta_description: Umlando wezinguquko wesistimu ye-Walk — okufakiwe kwangempela, okunesikhathi okudonswe bukhoma kusuka ku-three.ws okuphakelayo komlando wezinguquko womphakathi.
docs_walk_changelog.walk_related_entries_from_the_three_ws: Okufakiwe okuhlobene nokuhamba okuvela ku-changelog yomphakathi three.ws, kulayishwa bukhoma. Ukuze uthole umlando ophelele weplatifomu, i-RSS, nama-JSON feeds, bona three.ws/changelog.

docs_walk_chrome_extension.account_your_handle_and_a_sign_in: I-akhawunti — igama lakho lomsebenzisi kanye nesilawuli sokungena / sokuphuma.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.avatar_picker_three_tabs_my_avatars_sign: Isikhethi se-Avatar — amathebhu amathathu: Ama-Avatar Ami (ungenile), Afakiwe, kanye Nakamuva (izinketho zakho zokugcina). Ukukhetha eyodwa kuyenza ibe i-walker yakho.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.because_you_can_enable_the_avatar_on: Ngoba ungakwazi ukunika amandla i-avatar kunoma iyiphi isayithi oyivakashelayo. Ukufaka kusenzeka kuphela kumathebhu owanikayo amandla.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.bottom_right_left_top_right_left_or: Phansi kwesokudla / kwesokunxele, phezulu kwesokudla / kwesokunxele, noma landela isikhombisi.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.click_the_toolbar_icon_to_open_the: Chofoza isithonjana sebha yamathuluzi ukuze uvule i-popup:
docs_walk_chrome_extension.domains_where_it_never_appears_takes_pre: Izizinda lapho ingalokothi ivele khona (ithatha isinyathelo sokuqala).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.domains_where_the_avatar_may_appear_when: Izizinda lapho i-avatar ingase ivele khona (uma isethiwe, kuphela lezi).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.enable_on_this_site_a_toggle_that: Nika amandla kule sayithi — iswishi efaka/ikhipha i-avatar kuthebhu yamanje, nesizinda esibonisiwe. Ikhutshaziwe emakhasini avinjelwe (chrome://, njll.).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.everything_stays_on_your_device_except_t: Konke kuhlala kudivayisi yakho ngaphandle kwezicelo zombhalo-kuya-enkulumweni, ezithunyelwa ku-three.ws ukuze kuhlanganiswe umsindo. Imithetho yakho yesayithi nezintandokazi zigcinwa kusitoreji esivumelanisiwe se-Chrome.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.fetch_your_avatars_featured_avatars_and_: Landa ama-avatar akho, ama-avatar afakiwe, namazwi e-TTS, futhi unikeze i-iframe ehambayo.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.inject_the_avatar_into_your_active_tab: Faka i-avatar kuthebhu yakho esebenzayo — kuphela uma uyivula, ungalokothi ngokuzenzakalelayo.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.keep_the_avatar_in_sync_as_you: Gcina i-avatar ivumelanisiwe njengoba uzulazula, uhlola imithetho yesayithi lakho, futhi udlulisele izinguquko zezilungiselelo ezibukhoma kumathebhu afakiwe.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.light_dark_or_auto_samples_the_page: Okukhanyayo, Okumnyama, noma Okuzenzakalelayo (kuthatha isampula ingemuva lekhasi).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.meta_description: Isandiso seChrome se-three.ws Walk Avatar: hamba ne-avatar yakho kunoma iyiphi isayithi, lungiselela ukubukeka nemithetho yesayithi ngalinye, futhi amakhasi afundwe ngokuzwakalayo nge-text-to-speech. Faka, izimvume, nezilungiselelo.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.mounts_your_avatar_on_any_site_the: Ifaka i-avatar yakho kunoma iyiphi isayithi. I-avatar iyi-iframe efanayo esobala /walk-embed, efakwa kuthebhu yamanje uma uyivula.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.persist_your_chosen_avatar_walk_speed_po: Gcina i-avatar yakho ekhethiwe, isivinini sokuhamba, indawo, imithetho yesayithi, nezilungiselelo zokulandisa (kuvunyelaniswe kuwo wonke amadivayisi akho e-Chrome).
docs_walk_chrome_extension.read_the_current_tab_s_hostname_to: Funda igama lomethuleli wethebhu yamanje ukuze ubhale "Vumela kule sayithi" futhi udlulisele iswishi yakho kuleyo thebhu.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.reads_pages_aloud_optional_with_narratio: Ifunda amakhasi ngokuzwakalayo (ngokuzikhethela). Uma ukulandisa kunikwe amandla, ithola isihloko esikhulu, ilandelela okubonakalayo, futhi ikhulume izingxenye ezibonakalayo isebenzisa i-text-to-speech.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.requires_chrome_109_or_newer_manifest_v3: Idinga i-Chrome 109 noma entsha (Manifest V3). Ukuze upakishe ifayela le-zip elilungele isitolo, sebenzisa npm run build:extension:prod, elikhipha dist/extension-<version>.zip.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.respects_your_rules_per_site_enabling_pl: Ihlonipha imithetho yakho. Ukunika amandla isayithi ngalinye kanye nohlu oluvunyelwe/oluvinjelwe, futhi ayifaki ngokuzenzakalelayo — isebenza kuphela lapho ucela khona.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.small_medium_large_or_custom_width_heigh: Okuncane, Okumaphakathi, Okukhulu, noma ububanzi × ukuphakakama okwenziwe ngokwezifiso.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_is_built_from_this_reposit: Isandiso sakhiwe kule ndawo yokugcina futhi silayishwa singapakishwanga. (Silungiselelwe i-Chrome Web Store; uhlu olusesidlangalaleni alukatholakali okwamanje, ngakho silifake kumodi yonjiniyela.)
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_extension_requests_the_minimum_it_ne: Isandiso sicela okuncane esikudingayo futhi sifaka kuphela ngesenzo somsebenzisi esicacile.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.the_three_ws_walk_avatar_extension_v1: Isandiso se-three.ws Walk Avatar (v1.0.0) sibeka i-avatar ye-3D entantayo kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi oyivakashelayo. Ihamba eceleni kwakho futhi ingafunda izingxenye zekhasi ngokuzwakalayo — umngane wokuphequlula ophilayo. Isebenza kuphela kumathebhu owavumela ngokusobala.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.walk_speed_a_slider_from_0_5: Isivinini sokuhamba — isilayidi esisuka ku-0.5× siye ku-2.0×.
docs_walk_chrome_extension.with_narration_on_the_extension_parses_t: Uma ukulandisa kuvuliwe, isandiso sihlaziya isihloko esikhulu sekhasi (sisebenzisa isikhiphi se-Readability esifakiwe), sikhipha izihloko, izigaba, izinto ezisezingeni, kanye nama-blockquote, futhi sibheke ukuthi yisiphi isigaba esibonakalayo. Uma isigaba sigxila, sicela umsindo wenkulumo kusuka kusevisi ye-text-to-speech ye-three.ws bese siyidlala, ngenkathi sitshela i-avatar ukuthi ikhombise ibhamuza lenkulumo futhi ishintshele endaweni yokungasebenzi. Ukhetha izwi, ungathulisa phakathi nokufunda, futhi ukulandisa kuhlonipha prefers-reduced-motion. Ababhali bangamaka izigaba nge-data-walk-narrate (noma bazeqe nge-data-walk-narrate="skip").

docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_a_three_ws_site: Imodi yomngane iyisici sesayithi le-three.ws. Ukubeka i-avatar ehambayo kusayithi lakho, sebenzisa i-JavaScript SDK enethegi elilodwa; ukuhambisa i-avatar yakho kuwo wonke amasayithi owavakashelayo, faka isandiso se-Chrome.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_platform_integrati: Imodi yomngane iyinhlanganisela yesikhulumi ye-SDK yokuhamba ekwazi ukushicilelwa. Ukuzulazula kwe-three.ws kufaka iskripthi somngane kuphela uma umngane enikwe amandla — ikhasi elingalokothi liyivule alikhokhi lutho ngalo. Ngaphansi kwesembozo ilayisha imanuvesi ye-animation ye-avatar esivele yenziwe kanye nenjini yokunikeza efanayo esetshenziswa ikhasi lokuhamba kanye nokufaka.
docs_walk_companion_mode.companion_mode_is_the_site_wide_walking: Imodi yomngane iyi-avatar ehambayo yesayithi lonke ku-three.ws. Yivule bese i-avatar yakho iyahlukana ne-chrome yekhasi, ihamba izungeze isikrini, futhi ikulandele njengoba uhamba phakathi kwamakhasi — iphelele nezinguquko zamakhasi ezazi ukuhamba.
docs_walk_companion_mode.detaches_and_roams_your_avatar_leaves_th: Iyahamba futhi izulazule. I-avatar yakho ishiya isakhiwo sekhasi bese iba umlingiswa we-3D okhululekile ongambuka ehamba.
docs_walk_companion_mode.follows_you_between_pages_when_you_navig: Iyakulandela phakathi kwamakhasi. Uma uzulazula, umngane uyaqhubeka — nezinguquko zamakhasi ezazi ukuhamba zilungisa ukugxuma ukuze zifane nalapho uya khona.
docs_walk_companion_mode.meta_description: Imodi yomngane: i-avatar yesayithi lonke ye-three.ws ehlukana nekhasi, ihamba izungeze, futhi ikulandele phakathi kwamakhasi — ngezinguquko zamakhasi ezazi ukuhamba kanye nokushwiba-ukuvalelisa / ukushwiba-ukubingelela.
docs_walk_companion_mode.nav_button_the_walk_control_in_the: Inkinobho yokuzulazula — isilawuli Sokuhamba ekuzulazuleni okuphezulu sivula futhi sicime umngane. Okukhethwayo kuyakhunjulwa kuzo zonke izivakashi.
docs_walk_companion_mode.picks_an_avatar_the_picker_includes_a: Ikhetha i-avatar. Isikhethi sihlanganisa isixhumanisi "zokuzenzela" esiqonde ngqo ku-avatar studio.
docs_walk_companion_mode.programmatically_the_companion_instance_: Ngokuhlelekile — isibonelo somngane siyatholakala ku-window.__walkCompanion uma sesinikwe amandla (lena yindawo yokusebenzisana ekuzulazula okushayelayo).
docs_walk_companion_mode.query_parameter_append_to_any_three_ws: Ipharamitha yombuzo — faka ?walk=1 kunoma iyiphi i-URL ye-three.ws ukuze uyivule ngenkani, noma ?walk=0 ukuze uyivale ngenkani.
docs_walk_companion_mode.the_companion_and_its_page_transitions_r: Umlingani kanye nezinguquko zamakhasi akhe kuyayihlonipha i-prefers-reduced-motion. I-avatar ehambahambayo ingeyokuhlobisa; konke ukuzulazula nokuqukethwe kuhlala kusetshenziswa ngokugcwele ngaphandle komlingani, okuyisimo esizenzakalelayo uze ukhethe ukungena.
docs_walk_companion_mode.waves_goodbye_and_hello_on_a_link: Uvalelisa futhi abingelele. Uma kuchofozwa isixhumanisi, i-avatar idlala ukushwiba futhi isetha ifulegi elilodwa ikhasi eliya kulo elilifundayo ukuze libuyisele ukushwiba lapho lilayisha.

docs_walk_embed_api.a_command_was_rejected_or_a_load: Umyalo wenqatshwa noma ukulayisha kwehluleka. Akulokothi kube nesimo sangaphakathi.
docs_walk_embed_api.a_gesture_starts_playing_echoes_both_one: Ukushukuma komzimba kuqala ukudlala (kukhombisa kokubili okukodwa kanye nezinguquko zokuhamba).

docs_walk_embed_iframe.meta_description: Faka i-avatar three.ws ehambayo nge-iframe elula. Wonke ama-parameter ombuzo we-/walk-embed — i-avatar, izilawuli, i-env, i-autoplay, i-ground, i-orbit, i-bg — abhalwe phansi ngokubuka kuqala okubukhoma.

Ithumela ngokushesha futhi inika amandla i-funnel ku-ideshibhodi yokuhlaziya.

docs_walk_postmessage_events.every_message_is_a_plain_object_on: Yonke imiyalezo iyinto elula (plain object) esiteshini se-three-walk ngenguqulo yephrothokholi 1:
docs_walk_postmessage_events.host_iframe_optional_makes_the_iframe_re: host → iframe: walk:ping (ongakukhetha) kwenza i-iframe iphinde ikhiphe walk:loaded.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.if_you_mount_the_iframe_after_it: Uma ufaka i-iframe ngemuva kokuba isivele ilayishiwe, thumela walk:ping esikhundleni sokuncintisana ne-walk:loaded yokuqala.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.iframe_host_fires_once_when_the_avatar: iframe → host: walk:loaded iyakhala kanye, lapho i-avatar isilungile.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.meta_description: Isivumelwano se-postMessage esihamba ngezindlela ezimbili phakathi kwekhasi le-host ne-iframe ye-three.ws walk-embed: imvilophu esesiteshini, imiyalo engenayo, imicimbi ephumayo, ukuxhawulana, nokuphathwa kwe-origin.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.or: { x, y, run? } noma { dir, meters? }
docs_walk_postmessage_events.recenter_the_avatar_and_reset_its_pose: Phinda ugxilise i-avatar bese usetha kabusha ukuma kwayo.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.set_walk_speed_multiplier_clamps_to_0: Setha isiphindaphinda sejubane lokuhamba; sivalela ku-0.3–3.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.show_a_speech_bubble_text_is_capped: Bonisa ibhamuza lenkulumo. Umbhalo ukhawulelwe kumakhodi angu-280; isikhathi sivalela ku-800–20000 ms.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.swap_the_avatar_uuid_or_glb_vrm: Shintsha i-avatar (UUID noma GLB/VRM URL, ≤2048 amakhodi).
docs_walk_postmessage_events.the_embed_is_designed_to_run_on: I-embed yakhelwe ukusebenza kunoma iyiphi i-origin any (ithumela frame-ancestors *), ngakho i-origin ye-host ayikwazi ukufakwa ohlwini oluvunyelwe kusengaphambili. Ukuqinisekiswa kwangempela umthombo womyalezo source: i-iframe yamukela kuphela imiyalezo evela efasiteleni layo elingumzali, kanti i-host SDK yamukela kuphela imiyalezo evela kwi-iframe eyifakile. Njengesihlungi esiqinile, umhlanganisi oqaphela ukuphepha angadlulisela uhlu olucacile lwe-allowOrigins kwi-embed lapho i-origin eqondile yaziwa.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.the_host_page_and_the_iframe_talk: Ikhasi le-host ne-iframe ye-/walk-embed kukhuluma nge-window.postMessage. Lesi isivumelwano socingo: imvilophu yomyalezo, imiyalo oyithumelayo, imicimbi i-iframe eyithumelayo emuva, nokuthi ama-origin aphathwa kanjani.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.the_legacy_flat_shape_a_bare_with: Isimo esiyisicaba esidala — i-{ type: 'walk:*' } engenalutho engenaso isiteshi/v — isayamukelwa ngaphakathi ukuze ihambisane nezinto ezifakiwe ngaphambi kokuba kube khona lesi sivumelwano. Izinhlanganiso ezintsha kufanele zisebenzise imvilophu enesiteshi.
docs_walk_postmessage_events.using_the_javascript_sdk_it_does_the: Usebenzisa i-JavaScript SDK? Yenza ukuhlola umthombo, ukuqapha isiteshi, nokudlulisa imicimbi kuwe — vele ubize ThreeWalkAvatar.on('walk:ready', …).
docs_walk_postmessage_events.when_you_listen_for_events_on_the: Uma ulalela imicimbi ohlangothini lomsingathi, hlala uqinisekisa ukuthi event.source === iframe.contentWindow ngaphambi kokwethemba umlayezo, futhi uhlole ukuthi data.channel === 'three-walk' (noma ukuthi uhlobo olungenalutho luwumcimbi owaziwayo we-walk:*).

docs_walk_walk_page.a_minimal_grid_plane_under_a_soft: Indiza yegridi encane ngaphansi kwe-gradient ethambile — ukugxila okumsulwa.
docs_walk_walk_page.append_these_to_to_deep_link_into: Faka lokhu ku-/walk ukuze uxhume ngokujulile ekucushweni.
docs_walk_walk_page.ar_uses_the_device_camera_for_passthroug: I-AR isebenzisa ikhamera yedivayisi (getUserMedia) ukuze idlule — akuyona i-WebXR spatial AR, ngakho-ke akukho ukutholwa kwendiza noma ukubambelela emhlabeni. Idinga isiphequluli esinokufinyelela kukhamera futhi ibuyela emuva kahle ngomlayezo ocacile lapho i-API yekhamera ingatholakali khona.
docs_walk_walk_page.auto_orbiting_camera_that_periodically_c: Ikhamera ezungeza ngokuzenzakalela esika ngezikhathi ezithile iye engeli entsha.
docs_walk_walk_page.bright_sand_palms_parasols_and_a_turquoi: Isihlabathi esikhanyayo, amasundu, ama-parasol, nolwandle oluluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka.
docs_walk_walk_page.eight_gestures_play_on_top_of_or: Ukuthinta okuyisishiyagalombili kudlala phezu (noma esikhundleni) sokuhamba. Bamba <kbd>G</kbd> ukuze uthole isondo eliyindilinga, noma cindezela ukhiye wenombolo. Ukuthinta komzimba ongaphezulu kugqagqana nokuhamba ukuze i-avatar iqhubeke nokuhamba; ukuthinta komzimba ogcwele kuthatha indawo kuze kuqedwe.
docs_walk_walk_page.if_the_presence_server_is_unreachable_th: Uma iseva yokuba khona ingafinyeleleki, ikhasi lisasebenza kahle kakhulu — limane lisebenze lodwa. I-multiplayer iyisithuthukisi, akuyona neze imfuneko.
docs_walk_walk_page.label: Ilebula
docs_walk_walk_page.meta_description: Ikhasi lokuhamba le-three.ws: izilawuli zekhibhodi nezokuthinta, izindlela zekhamera ezine, izindawo eziyisithupha, ukuthinta okuyisishiyagalombili, ukuba khona kwe-multiplayer bukhoma, i-AR camera passthrough, kanye namapharamitha e-URL eliwafundayo.
docs_walk_walk_page.name: Igama
docs_walk_walk_page.neon_towers_and_holo_signs_over_a: Imibhoshongo ye-neon nezimpawu ze-holo phezu komgwaqo omnyama ngenxa yemvula.
docs_walk_walk_page.on_a_phone_the_ar_button_drops: Efonini, inkinobho ye-AR ifaka i-avatar endaweni yakho yangempela. Isakaza ikhamera yangemuva njengesizinda, ifihla indawo eyakhiwe ngokuhlelekile, igcina isithwebuli sezithunzi ngaphansi kwezinyawo ze-avatar, iqandisa ikhamera endaweni yomhlaba, futhi ihlola njalo ividiyo ebukhoma ukuze ifanise ukukhanya kwe-avatar negumbi lakho.
docs_walk_walk_page.on_desktop_the_avatar_is_driven_with: Kudeskithophu, i-avatar ilawulwa ngekhibhodi; igundane lizungezisa ikhamera.
docs_walk_walk_page.on_touch_devices_the_page_shows_dual: Kumadivayisi okuthinta, ikhasi libonisa izinduku ezimbili esikrinini — induku yesokunxele ihambisa i-avatar, induku yesokudla izungezisa ikhamera — kanye nezinkinobho zokugxuma, zekhamera, nezokuthinta. Bamba inkinobho yokuthinta ukuze uvule isondo eliyindilinga.
docs_walk_walk_page.press_c_or_tap_the_camera_button: Cindezela <kbd>C</kbd> (noma thepha inkinobho yekhamera) ukuze ujikeleze ezindleleni ezine. Ukukhetha kwakho kuhlala kuzo zonke izikhathi.
docs_walk_walk_page.rolling_green_with_shade_trees_benches_a: Indawo eluhlaza egudlukayo enezihlahla zomthunzi, amabhentshi, nezinsika zezibani. (okuzenzakalelayo)
docs_walk_walk_page.six_worlds_each_with_its_own_terrain: Imihlaba eyisithupha, ngamunye unendawo yawo, isibhakabhaka, nokukhanya. Jikelezisa nge-V, noma wehle ngqo komunye ngepharamitha ye-URL ethi ?env=.
docs_walk_walk_page.the_three_ws_virtual_office_desks_plants: Ihhovisi elibonakalayo le-three.ws — amadeski, izitshalo, udonga lomkhiqizo.
docs_walk_walk_page.the_walk_page_connects_to_a_real: Ikhasi lokuhamba lixhuma kuseva yokuba khona ngesikhathi sangempela, ngakho-ke lapho abanye bekhona emhlabeni ofanayo uyabona behamba, benza izenzo, futhi bexoxa bukhoma. Indawo, ukuqondana, ukunyakaza, igama, umbala, kanye ne-avatar yomhambi ngamunye okude kuvumelaniswa ngokuqhubekayo. Iphilisi lesimo libonisa ku-inthanethi, liyaxhuma, yedwa, noma aku-inthanethi, futhi uhlu lwabadlali lubala wonke umuntu okhona.
docs_walk_walk_page.three_ws_walk_is_the_full_experience: three.ws/walk yilona ulwazi oluphelele: hambisa i-avatar emhlabeni we-3D oyisithupha, shintsha phakathi kwezindlela zekhamera ezine, yenza izenzo, bona abanye abahambi bukhoma, futhi ungene ku-AR. Leli khasi libhala izilawuli ngendlela ezithunyelwa ngayo.
docs_walk_walk_page.walkers_are_grouped_into_shared_rooms_by: Abahambi bahlelwa emakamelweni okwabelwana ngawo ngomphakathi we-?coin abafika nawo — dlulisa i-Solana mint negama elinobungane ukuze ubeke umphakathi ekamelweni elilodwa ndawonye:
docs_walk_walk_page.white_walled_exhibition_space_with_pedes: Indawo yombukiso enezindonga ezimhlophe enezisekelo nobuciko obulengayo.

docs_widgets.a_widget_is_a_saved_bundle_of: Iwijethi iyinqwaba elondoloziwe ye: i-avatar (GLB egcinwe ku-R2), uhlobo lwezijethi (i-turntable, igalari yopopayi, i-ejenti ekhulumayo, ipasipoti ye-ERC-8004, uhambo lwe-hotspot), kanye nokumiswa komkhiqizo (ingemuva, umbala ogqamile, isihloko, izilawuli, ikhamera). Amawijethi akhiwa ku-Widget Studio futhi abelwana ngawo ngama-URL amafushane.
docs_widgets.can_i_self_host_the_runtime_is: Ngingakwazi yini ukuzisingatha? I-runtime iyi-open source. I-Studio + i-API yama-wijethi agciniwe incike ku-Neon + R2; kuzodingeka uzixhume wena. Bona umhlahlandlela wokufaka.
docs_widgets.copy_the_iframe_snippet_into_any_html: Kopisha isiqeshana se-iframe kunoma yiliphi ikhasi le-HTML, okuthunyelwe kubhulogi, idokhumenti ye-Notion, noma i-CMS.
docs_widgets.embeddable_3d_a_configured_shareable_vie: I-3D efakwayo — umbono olungisiwe, ongabiwa we-avatar ongashumekwa yinoma iyiphi isayithi ngomugqa owodwa we-HTML.
docs_widgets.embodied_chat_your_agent_on_your_site: Ingxoxo ebonakalayo — i-ejenti yakho kusayithi lakho.
docs_widgets.every_widget_url_serves_rich_preview_met: Isixhumanisi sewijethi ngayinye sinikeza imethadatha yokubuka kuqala ecebile. /w/<id> sihunyushwa iseva ngamathegi e-Open Graph + Twitter card kanye nesikhombi <link rel="alternate" type="application/json+oembed">.
docs_widgets.hero_banners_product_showcases_auto_rota: Izibhengezo eziyinhloko, imibukiso yomkhiqizo. Zizungeza ngokwazo, ayikho i-UI.
docs_widgets.hides_the_header_chrome_for_clean_iframe: Ifihla i-chrome yesihloko ukuze kushumekwe ama-iframe ahlanzekile.
docs_widgets.how_big_is_the_bundle_cold_load: Ingakanani i-bundle? Ukulayisha okubandayo ~400KB JS + GLB uqobo.
docs_widgets.legacy_spa_viewer_still_works_but_includ: Isibukeli se-SPA esidala — sisasebenza, kodwa sihlanganisa i-chrome yohlelo lokusebenza olukhulu oluphelele.
docs_widgets.meta_description: Shumeka amawijethi e-3D kunoma iyiphi isayithi. Amapharamitha e-URL, ukushumeka kwe-iframe + skripthi, i-API ye-postMessage, i-oEmbed, ubumfihlo.

docs_widgets.meta_twitter_description: Yakha futhi ushicilele amawijethi engxoxo ne-3D angasetshenziswa kabusha.
docs_widgets.mobile_yes_every_widget_type_works_on: Iselula? Yebo — zonke izinhlobo zewijethi zisebenza ku-iOS Safari naku-Android Chrome.
docs_widgets.most_cmses_auto_detect_oembed_paste_a: Ama-CMS amaningi athola ngokuzenzakalelayo i-oEmbed. Namathisela i-URL /w/<id> kumugqa wayo futhi umhleli kufanele ayiguqule ibe ukushumeka okubukhoma ngokuzenzakalelayo.
docs_widgets.pick_an_avatar_pick_a_widget_type: Khetha i-avatar, khetha uhlobo lwezijethi, lungisa imibala yomkhiqizo nezilawuli, chofoza Khiqiza Ukushumeka.
docs_widgets.returns_standard_oembed_v1_0_json_type: Ibuyisa i-JSON ejwayelekile ye-oEmbed v1.0, uhlobo olucebile. Yamukela amafomu /w/<id>, /widget#widget=<id>, kanye namafomu adala /app#widget=<id>.
docs_widgets.sharing_in_slack_discord_x_server_render: Ukwabelana ku-Slack/Discord/X — okwenziwe yi-server ngekhadi le-OG elicebile.
docs_widgets.showcasing_a_rigged_avatar_s_animation_l: Kuboniswa umtapo wolwazi wokugqwayiza we-avatar elungisiwe.
docs_widgets.slim_viewer_shell_no_nav_footer_chrome: I-shell yokubuka encane — ngaphandle kwe-nav/footer chrome. I-URL yokufaka esemthethweni.
docs_widgets.we_log_a_minimal_first_party_event: Siloga umcimbi omncane wokuqala nge-widget ngayinye elayishwayo: widget_id, type, country (i-header ye-Vercel edge), referer_host (igama lomethuleli kuphela), created_at. Azikho izi-IP. Azikho izi-cookie. Azikho izi-user agent. Akukho okuqukethwe yingxoxo. Akukho ukulandelela okuwela ama-widget.
docs_widgets.why_no_wordpress_plugin_the_oembed_endpo: Kungani kungekho i-plugin ye-WordPress? I-oEmbed endpoint isivele yenza lokho i-plugin ebiyokwenza.
docs_widgets.widgets_communicate_with_the_parent_page: Ama-widget axhumana nekhasi eliyinhloko nge-window.postMessage. Hlala uhlola event.origin ngaphambi kokwethemba noma yimuphi umyalezo.
docs_widgets.widgets_run_in_a_sandboxed_iframe_with: Ama-widget asebenza ku-iframe evikelwe ngala ma-allow amafulegi: autoplay, xr-spatial-tracking, clipboard-write. Uma isayithi lakho lisebenzisa i-CSP eqinile, vumela:

embed_v1_preview.embedded_agent_click_and_drag_to_inspect: I-ejenti eshumekiwe — chofoza bese uhudula ukuze uhlole.

features.drive_your_avatar_around_a_3d_scene: Shayela i-avatar yakho endaweni ye-3D nge-WASD noma i-joystick yokuthinta. Shintshela kumodi yekhamera yangemuva bese i-avatar yakho ihamba endaweni yakho yangempela.
features.every_avatar_and_forge_model_has_a: Yonke i-avatar nemodeli ye-Forge inenkinobho ethi Buka ku-AR. Kuselula, ibopha imodeli ezindaweni zangempela ngekhamera. Ku-desktop, ikhodi ye-QR ikuvumela ukuthi uskene bese ubeka ngokuthepha okukodwa. Ayikho i-app edingekayo.
features.follow_along_for_builds_demos_and_conver: Landela ukuze ubone izakhiwo, imibukiso, nezingxoxo neqembu.
features.for_anyone_running_one_or_more_agents: Okwalaba: noma ubani osebenzisa i-agent eyodwa noma ngaphezulu ofuna iphaneli yokulawula eyodwa esikhundleni senqwaba yezixhumanisi ezihlakazekile.
features.for_anyone_who_wants_to_experience_their: Okwalaba: noma ubani ofuna ukuzwa i-avatar yakhe emhlabeni wangempela, noma abonise i-agent emcimbini.
features.for_anyone_who_wants_to_see_their: Okwalaba: noma ubani ofuna ukubona i-agent yakhe ye-3D ngesilinganiso sangempela — etafuleni lakhe, phansi, noma eshalofini.
features.for_builders_curious_about_autonomous_ag: Okwalaba: abakhi abafuna ukwazi ngezomnotho wama-agent azimele, noma noma ubani ofuna ukunikeza isevisi ekhokhelwa ezinye izinhlelo ze-AI.
features.for_builders_who_need_original_3d_charac: Okwalaba: abakhi abadinga abalingiswa be-3D bangempela ngokushesha, ngaphandle kwe-Blender.
features.for_builders_who_want_their_agent_to: Okwalaba: abakhi abafuna i-agent yabo ibe ephathekayo, edluliselwekayo, futhi itholakale ezinye izinhlelo ze-AI.
features.for_creators_who_have_built_something_us: Okwalaba: abadali abakhe okuthile okuwusizo futhi bafuna ukukukhokhisa ngaphandle kokwakha ingqalasizinda yokukhokha.
features.for_creators_who_want_a_community_and: Okwalaba: abadali abafuna umphakathi nemakethe ebukhoma ezungeze i-agent yabo.
features.for_creators_who_want_a_personal_avatar: Okwalaba: abadali abafuna i-avatar yomuntu siqu ngaphandle kokuqasha umculi we-3D.
features.for_crypto_enthusiasts_who_want_a_more: Okwalaba: abathandi be-crypto abafuna indlela ebonakalayo yokulandela imakethe.
features.for_developers_and_creators_who_want_a: Okwalaba: abathuthukisi nabadali abafuna i-AI exoxayo enobukhona obubonakalayo bangempela.
features.for_enterprise_teams_evaluating_ibm_wats: Okwalaba: amaqembu ezinkampani ahlola i-IBM watsonx, noma abathuthukisi abafuna ukubona ukuthi amamodeli e-Granite angenzani ngaphakathi kwendawo ye-3D ebukhoma.
features.for_site_owners_who_want_a_3d: Okwalaba: abanikazi bamasayithi abafuna umsizi we-AI we-3D ekhasini labo ngaphandle kokuthinta ikhodi ye-backend.
features.free_to_start_no_credit_card_required: Kumahhala ukuqala. Ayikho ikhadi lesikweletu elidingekayo.
features.get_updates_on_new_features_agent_toolin: Thola izibuyekezo ngezici ezintsha, amathuluzi e-agent, nezinguquko zeprotocol.
features.give_your_agent_a_community_token_in: Nikeza i-agent yakho ithokheni yomphakathi ngokuchofoza okumbalwa — setha igama nesithombe, futhi izoqala ukusebenza emakethe ye-pump.fun bonding-curve lapho noma ubani angadayisa khona.
features.list_your_agent_s_skills_for_others: Faka ohlwini amakhono e-agent yakho ukuze abanye bathenge. Ucingo ngalunye lukhokhelwa nge-USDC (idola ledijithali elingu-$1) nge-pay-per-call — inkokhelo iya ngqo esikhwameni sakho.
features.make_avatars_build_ai_agents_and_put: Yakha ama-avatar, akha ama-agent e-AI, futhi uwabeke noma kuphi. Kumahhala ukuqala, ayikho i-wallet edingekayo.
features.meta_description: Zonke izici ze-three.ws endaweni eyodwa: dala ama-avatar e-3D, faka ama-agent kunoma iyiphi iwebhusayithi, hlola imihlaba yezinhlamvu zemali, futhi uzuze ngamakhono akhokhelwa ngocingo.

features.meta_twitter_description: Dala ama-avatar e-3D, faka ama-agent noma kuphi, hlola imihlaba yezinhlamvu zemali, futhi uzuze ngamakhono akhokhelwa ngocingo.
features.needs_a_wallet_0_01_network_fee: Kudingeka: isikhwama semali · imali yenethiwekhi engu-$0.01
features.no_crypto_needed_everything_in_this_sect: Ayikho i-crypto edingekayo. Konke okukulesi sigaba kusebenza nge-imeyili nje — asikho isikhwama semali, awekho amathokheni, ayikho i-blockchain. Bhalisa bese uqala ngemizuzu.
features.one_home_for_everything_you_have_made: Ikhaya elilodwa lakho konke okwenzile — hlela ubuntu be-agent ngayinye, shintsha izithombe zayo ezinyakazayo, kopisha amakhodi okufaka, futhi ubuke umsebenzi wengxoxo ungena njengoba kwenzeka.
features.one_transaction_on_solana_gives_your_age: Ukuthengiselana okukodwa ku-Solana kunikeza i-agent yakho ubunikazi obuhlala njalo, obuqinisekisekayo — impahla ye-Metaplex Core engatholakala futhi ithenjwe yinoma yimuphi umthengi we-A2A noma MCP.
features.pick_an_avatar_configure_size_and_style: Khetha i-avatar, lungiselela usayizi nesitayela, bese ukopisha ithegi yeskripthi elilodwa. Lifake ku-Notion, Ghost, WordPress, Framer — noma kuphi.
features.pick_any_animation_below_your_avatar_swi: Khetha noma yisiphi isithombe esinyakazayo ngezansi. I-avatar yakho iyashintsha ngokushesha — akukho ukuvuselela ikhasi, akukho ukufaka. Lokhu kusebenza kunoma iyiphi idivayisi, kunoma yikuphi okufakiwe.
features.put_agents_on_chain_charge_for_what: Faka ama-agent ku-chain, khokhisa ngalokho akwenzayo, bese uqala ithokheni. Kunamandla, kodwa akudingeki neze.
features.start_free_add_crypto_only_if_you:
Qala mahhala.
Faka i-crypto kuphela uma uyifuna.
features.take_one_photo_and_get_back_a: Thatha isithombe esisodwa bese uthola i-avatar ye-3D elungiswe ngokuphelele cishe ngemizuzwana engu-60.
features.the_latest_features_each_linked_to_the: Izici zakamuva nokuqaliswa, ngakunye kuxhunywe ekhasini elibukhoma. Lolu hlu luzibuyekeza ngayo yonke inguqulo.
features.the_web_component_lazy_loads_renders_on: I-web component ye-<agent-3d> ilayisha kancane, ibonakala kunoma iyiphi idivayisi, futhi ixhuma ku-AI stack yakho ekhona nge-MCP noma i-A2A. Ayikho i-framework. Ayikho i-build step.
features.the_whole_product_making_avatars_buildin: Umkhiqizo wonke — ukwenza ama-avatar, ukwakha ama-AI agent, ukuwafaka noma kuphi — usebenza nge-imeyili kuphela. Izici ze-on-chain ezingezansi ziyizengezo ozikhethelayo ongazivula kamuva.
features.these_features_use_crypto_to_switch_them: Lezi zici zisebenzisa i-crypto. Ukuze uzivule uzodinga i-wallet kanye nemali encane ye-USDC noma i-SOL. Zeqe ngokuphelele futhi umkhiqizo oyinhloko ongenhla usazosebenza ngokugcwele.
features.walk_your_avatar_through_3d_worlds_tied: Hamba ne-avatar yakho emhlabeni we-3D oxhunywe ezintengo ze-crypto ezibukhoma. Indawo iyashintsha nemakethe — umhlaba ngamunye uyindawo ye-token ehlukile.
features.watch_two_ai_agents_oracle_and_nova: Buka ama-AI agent amabili — i-ORACLE ne-NOVA — exoxisana, ebiza amakhono omunye nomunye, futhi ekhokha ngokuzenzakalela ku-on-chain. Akukho bantu ababandakanyekile.
features.why_it_s_better_agents_in_the: Kungani kungcono: Ama-agent emhlabeni akhokhelana ku-on-chain ngesikhathi sangempela — ungabuka ukuthengiselana kwama-micropayment e-x402 okubukhoma kwenzeka njengoba uhamba.
features.why_it_s_better_any_llm_works: Kungani kungcono: Noma iyiphi i-LLM isebenza nge-MCP noma i-A2A — i-Claude, i-GPT, i-Gemini, noma eyakho. Akukho ukukhiya umthengisi.
features.why_it_s_better_every_avatar_and: Kungani kungcono: Yonke i-avatar ne-agent oyakhayo ivela lapha ngokuzenzakalela — akukho okudinga ukuxhunywa, ukungena okukodwa kukho konke.
features.why_it_s_better_it_s_a: Kungani kungcono: Ukwethulwa kwangempela ngokuhweba okubukhoma kusukela kumzuzwana wokuqala — wena unikeza imininingwane, thina siphethe izindlela ze-on-chain.
features.why_it_s_better_no_app_install: Kungani kungcono: Akukho ukufakwa kohlelo lokusebenza — lusebenza kusiphequluli nge-physics yangempela (i-Rapier) nendawo yangempela, hhayi indawo eyisicaba.
features.why_it_s_better_no_sdk_required: Kungani kungcono: Ayikho i-SDK edingekayo ohlangothini lomthengi — ithegi elilodwa, noma yiliphi ikhasi, akukho build step.
features.why_it_s_better_outputs_are_glb: Kungani kungcono: Okukhiphayo kulungele i-GLB — kulayishe ngqo kusibukeli, kusebenzise, noma ukufake ngaphandle kwesinyathelo sokuguqula.
features.why_it_s_better_pay_per_call: Kungani kungcono: Ukukhokha ngekholi kusho ukuthi akukho okubhaliselwe okumele kulawulwe — abathengi bakhokha ngqo lokho abakusebenzisayo, futhi ukhokhelwa ngekholi ngayinye.
features.why_it_s_better_real_on_chain: Kungani kungcono: Ukukhokha kwangempela ku-on-chain nge-pay-per-call (ama-micropayment) — konke ukuthengiselana kungaqinisekiswa, akukho okulingisiwe.
features.why_it_s_better_sub_cent_fees: Kungani kungcono: Izimali ezingaphansi kwesenti. Ugcine okhiye. Ikhadi le-agent liyi-URL ye-JSON yomphakathi — akukho okukhiyelwe kule sayithi.
features.why_it_s_better_the_rig_is: Kungani kungcono: I-rig ilungele i-animation — ungayilayisha ngqo kusibukeli bese uqala noma iyiphi i-animation ngokushesha.
features.why_it_s_better_these_are_real: Kungani kungcono: Lezi yizingcingo ze-API zangempela ze-Granite — azikho ezilingisiwe — ngaso sonke isinqumo esixhunywe ekuthengiselaneni kwe-Solana njengerekhodi elingaguquki.
features.why_it_s_better_three_ar_methods: Kungani kungcono: Izindlela ezintathu ze-AR enkinobho eyodwa — i-iOS Quick Look, i-Android Scene Viewer, ne-WebXR. Okulungile kuqala ngokuzenzakalela. I-agent ihlala ibukhoma ku-WebXR, ngakho ingxoxo nama-animation asebenza ku-AR.

features_agent_exchange.built_on_the_open_x402_http_payment: Yakhelwe phezu kwezinga lokukhokha le-HTTP elivulekile x402 — noma yimuphi umthengi we-HTTP osekela ukuxhawulana kwe-402 / ubufakazi bokukhokha angaba umthengi noma umthengisi kulo mnotho.
features_agent_exchange.every_transaction_appears_in_the_live_fe: Konke okwenziwayo kuvela kuphaneli yokuphakelwa bukhoma nge-hash ye-tx Solana, inani ku-USDC, kanye nesimo sokuqinisekisa. Ungaqinisekisa noma yikuphi okwenziwayo ku-Solana Explorer ngokuzimela.
features_agent_exchange.meta_description: Buka abenzeli be-AI ababili abane-avatar ye-3D bexoxisana futhi bekhokhelana ngobuhlakani be-crypto besebenzisa izinkokhelo ezincane ze-x402 ku-Solana. Konke okwenziwayo kuqinisekiswa ku-chain — bukhoma.

features_agent_exchange.neither_agent_is_simulated_both_hold_sol: Akekho umenzeli olingisiwe. Bobabili banama-wallet e-Solana afakwe imali ye-USDC yangempela. Yonke inkokhelo iyitransaction eqinisekisiwe ku-chain — hhayi ukulingisa noma ukungena encwadini.
features_agent_exchange.nova_s_endpoint_responds_with_a_402: I-endpoint ye-NOVA iphendula nge-402 Payment Required kanye nesilinganiso sentengo. I-wallet ye-ORACLE igunyaza inkokhelo, isayine itransaction ye-Solana, bese iphinda icele — I-NOVA iqinisekisa ukuxazululwa ku-chain bese ibuyisa idatha.
features_agent_exchange.open_the_agent_exchange_and_see_every: Vula i-Agent Exchange bese ubona yonke itransaction ku-chain yenzeka ngesikhathi sangempela.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_are_two_ai_agents: I-ORACLE ne-NOVA abenzeli be-AI ababili abane-avatar ye-3D nama-wallet e-Solana angempela. Bathenga futhi bathengise ngokuzenzakalelayo ubuhlakani be-crypto komunye nomunye ngezinkokhelo ezincane ze-x402 — yonke itransaction iqinisekiswa ku-chain, ibonakala ngesikhathi sangempela.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_and_nova_have_distinct_3d_avatars: I-ORACLE ne-NOVA bane-avatar ye-3D ehlukile, amazwi, kanye nobunikazi ku-chain — ubabona njengabantu abaxoxisanayo, hhayi njengamakholi e-API angenabuso.
features_agent_exchange.oracle_decides_it_needs_crypto_market_da: I-ORACLE inquma ukuthi idinga idatha yemakethe ye-crypto. Ithola i-NOVA njengomhlinzeki wedatha kukhathalogi yesevisi ye-x402 bese ikhipha isicelo se-API esikhokhelwayo — ikholi ye-HTTP ejwayelekile enesihloko sobufakazi bokukhokha.
features_agent_exchange.the_three_ws_agent_sdk_implements_the: I-SDK yomenzeli ye-three.ws isebenzisa ngokugcwele inqubo ye-x402 ngaphandle kokudinga ukulungiswa. Noma yimuphi umenzeli owakhayo angabiza amakhono akhokhelwayo futhi azuze ngokubonisa amakhono akhe — ingqalasizinda efanayo esetshenziswa yi-ORACLE ne-NOVA.

features_ar.add_the_attribute_to_your_tag_the: Faka isibaluli ar kuthegi yakho <agent-3d>. Inkinobho ye-AR ivela ngokuzenzakalelayo kumadivayisi eselula asekelwayo. Akukho okunye okudingekayo.
features_ar.android_chrome_launches_google_s_scene_v: I-Android Chrome yethula i-Scene Viewer yakwaGoogle nge-ARCore. Amafayela e-GLB alayisha ngqo — akukho ukuguqulwa okudingekayo. Izithombe ezinyakazayo ziyadlala. Akukho ukuxoxa.
features_ar.desktop_shows_a_qr_code_scan_it: Ideskithophu ikhombisa ikhodi ye-QR. Skena ngocingo lwakho futhi ulwazi lwe-AR luvuleka ngqo — akukho zinyathelo ezengeziwe, akukho hlelo lokusebenza olwengeziwe.

I-WebXR ku-Android, i-Quick Look ku-iOS. Ayikho i-app. Akukho ukulanda.

features_ar.on_any_desktop_browser_the_ar_tab: Kunoma yisiphi isiphequluli sedeskithophu, ithebhu ye-AR ikhombisa ikhodi ye-QR esikhundleni senkinobho yokuqalisa. Skena ngefoni yakho bese isipiliyoni se-AR siyavuleka — imodeli ifakiwe, akukho kudingeka ukusesha kwesibili.
features_ar.open_any_avatar_or_forge_model_on: Vula noma iyiphi i-avatar noma imodeli ye-Forge ku-three.ws, shintshela kuthebhu ye-AR, bese uthepha okuthi Faka endaweni yakho.
features_ar.place_a_forged_3d_product_on_a: Beka umkhiqizo we-3D owakhiwe eshalofini langempela ngaphambi kokuzibophezela ekukhiqizeni. Bona ubukhulu obuqondile nokuqedwa endaweni yakho yangempela.
features_ar.place_characters_props_and_scenes_in_rea: Beka abalingiswa, izinsiza, nezigcawu ezindaweni zangempela ukuze udale okuqukethwe, ukumaketha, noma izipiliyoni ezisebenzisanayo.
features_ar.see_exactly_how_large_a_model_is: Bona kahle ukuthi imodeli inkulu kangakanani ngesikali sangempela ngaphambi kokuzibophezela ekuphrinteni kwe-3D, kumodeli yangempela, noma ekukhiqizeni.
features_ar.tap_place_in_your_space_the_model: Thepha Faka endaweni yakho. Imodeli ivela ibambelele kulowo mhlaba ngesikali sangempela. Hamba uyizungeleze. Ncinza ukuze ushintshe usayizi.
features_ar.the_camera_scans_for_flat_surfaces_floor: Ikhamera iskena izindawo eziyisicaba — phansi, ideski, itafula. I-reticle iyavela uma kutholakala indawo eyisicaba futhi isilungele ukubekwa.
features_ar.the_most_powerful_method_the_page_itself: Indlela enamandla kakhulu. Ikhasi ngokwalo liba umbono we-AR — i-agent ihlala iphila ngokugcwele. Izithombe ezinyakazayo, ingxoxo yezwi, amakhono, namathuluzi konke kusebenza ku-AR. I-agent ilandelela ikhamera ye-XR njengekhanda lakho.
features_ar.three_ws_selects_the_right_method_automa: three.ws ikhetha indlela efanele ngokuzenzakalelayo — awukhethi neze. Ngayinye inezinkinga ezahlukene kuye ngokuthi idivayisi nesiphequluli kusekela ini.
features_ar.your_ai_agent_with_its_3d_body: I-agent yakho ye-AI — enomzimba wayo we-3D nobuntu obukhoma — imi egumbini elilodwa nawe. Khuluma nayo ku-AR, uthole izimpendulo zangempela.

features_deploy.because_the_identity_is_an_nft_it: Ngenxa yokuthi ubunikazi buyi-NFT, bungadlulisa noma buthengiswe. Noma ubani ophethe i-NFT ulawula ukumelelwa kwe-agent ku-chain futhi uqoqa izimali zayo zamakhono.
features_deploy.click_deploy_the_ui_previews_the_transac: Chofoza okuthi Deploy. I-UI ibonisa kuqala umsebenzi kanye nedatha ngaphambi kokuthi usayine. I-Metaplex Core iminta i-NFT bese ibhala isethi yezimpawu ERC-8004 — igama, amakhono, i-avatar URI, i-endpoint — ngqo ku-chain.
features_deploy.every_agent_minted_through_three_ws_carr: Wonke umenzeli oklanywe nge-three.ws uphethe uphawu lokuklanywa oluthi "3ws" — isitembu sobunikazi esiqinisekisekayo esixhumanisa umenzeli kule nkundla.
features_deploy.fill_in_your_agent_s_name_description: Faka igama lomenzeli wakho, incazelo, amathegi amakhono, nesithombe ku-Deploy UI. Namathisela i-GLB ye-3D ofuna ukuyiklanyela ku-chain — ekhiqizwe yi-Forge, eskeniwe, noma engenisiwe.

features_forge.every_generated_model_opens_in_webxr_ar: Yonke imodeli ekhiqiziwe ivula kumodi ye-WebXR AR ngokuthepha okukodwa — yibeke edeskini lakho langempela noma phansi bese uhamba uzungeze yona.

Chaza noma iyiphi into bese uhamba no-GLB onokuthungwa ongakwazi ukukuzungezisa ku-AR, ukufaka noma kuphi, noma ukunamathisela ku-ejenti yakho ye-AI.
